resources.string: Point at a barcode to spot mammal meat, dairy & gluten
GalSafe uses your camera to scan product barcodes in real time. You can also scan a barcode from a saved photo or type a UPC manually.

GalSafe is an informational aid for Alpha-Gal Syndrome, dairy avoidance, and Celiac Disease—not medical advice. Product formulas can change and crowd-sourced databases may be incomplete, so always read the physical package label and allergen statement before eating.

Camera frames are processed on your device to detect barcodes. Only scanned barcode numbers, ingredient text, or label photos you choose to analyze are sent to Open Food Facts and Firebase AI Logic. Your scan history and preferences stay stored locally on your device.
